issue.title: Improve container image repository checks for some dev services
issue.body:
This commit improves container image name checks for these dev services:

- Apicurio Registry
- ActiveMQ Artemis (AMQP)
- RabbitMQ

These dev services used to verify that the image repository is equal
to a hard-coded string. This commit changes that to verify that
the image repository _ends with_ the same hard-coded string, which
allows for repository namespacing in private container registries.

Fixes https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/24308

issue.title: Allow to configure Quartz misfire handling strategy globally that will be applied to all @Scheduled methods
issue.body:
### Description

At the moment we rely on the default strategy. 
It will be useful to define all the supported strategies by quartz and define and expose them as `quarkus.quartz.misfire-strategy`. 


### Implementation ideas

Ddefine all the supported strategies by quartz and define and enum type out of them. 
Then we can expose as a quartz runtime configuration `quarkus.quartz.misfire-strategy`, which defaults to the current Quartz default. 
- The configuration will reside in `QuartzRuntimeConfig`


Fixes #26208
